label.zh:
泽珞
一种在异星粒子中存在的极其稀有的气溶胶，随着陨石撞击被一起发现。不过其真正的来源依然是个未解之谜。若拥有灵能天赋的[GetIndividualNamePlural]将泽珞[GetIngestedLoc]后，它会是一种能极大的提高灵能力量（并可能导致成瘾）的[GetDrugLoc]。
label.en:
Zro
An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If [GetIngestedLoc] by psionically-gifted [GetIndividualNamePlural], zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) [GetDrugLoc] that enhances psionic abilities.

label.zh: 获得一个新的研究选项（由游戏按条件选择）

label.zh:
稀有水晶
这些水晶拥有独特的属性，非常适合用来凝聚和集中激光束，同时也是制作大部分高级电子器材的关键材料。部分文化也视之为装饰物。
label.en:
Rare Crystals
These crystals have properties that make them extremely effective at focusing laser beams, and they are also a critical component in most advanced electronics. In addition, many cultures treasure them as decorations and adornments.

when.en: resource: type = rare crystals, and amount > 0

label.en: If: resource: type = exotic gases, and amount > 0

label.zh:
异星天然气
罕见的异星天然气拥有各种用途，主要是用来为高级能量武器和能量力场提供能源。部分也用作舰船燃料或消遣性毒品。
label.en:
Exotic Gases
Rare and exotic gases with a variety of different uses, particularly in the operation of advanced energy-based weaponry and force fields. Some of the gases can also be used as starship fuel or even as recreational drugs.

when.en: resource: type = exotic gases, and amount > 0

label.en: If: resource: type = volatile motes, and amount > 0

label.zh:
易爆微粒
这些超自然粒子蕴含有惊人的能量，可以被精炼为能源或者用作燃料和炸药。
label.en:
Volatile Motes
These preternatural particles contain a tremendous amount of energy which could be exploited in energy production, as fuel or even as explosives.

when.en: resource: type = volatile motes, and amount > 0

label.zh:
暗物质
这种神秘物质具有许多似乎可以打破所谓自然法则的性质。该物质仅在黑洞周围或部分星云附近才能达到可供开采的浓度。
label.en:
Dark Matter
This exotic substance has many properties that seemingly defy several natural laws. Harvestable concentrations can only be found near Black Holes or in certain nebulas.

when.en: resource: type = sr dark matter, and amount > 0

label.zh:
活体金属
该无机金属有着通常生命体才具备的特征。会自动恢复到其被塑造好的形态。
label.en:
Living Metal
This inorganic metal shows characteristics usually seen only in biological life forms. It will always attempt to regenerate back into the shape it was stabilized into.

when.en: resource: type = sr living metal, and amount > 0

label.en: If: resource: type = astral threads, and amount > 0

label.zh:
星界丝缕
星界丝缕是一种时空浓缩而来的细丝，是不同维度位面互相碰撞的产物。可以用来产生各种全国范围的效果。
label.en:
Astral Threads
 Astral Threads are filaments of condensed space-time: the result of dimensional planes colliding with one another. They can be spent to enact various empire-wide effects.

when.en: resource: type = astral threads, and amount > 0
